answer: Use proof-of-work on registration with a rising price. Each new account must solve a puzzle costing about 4 CPU-minutes, and the difficulty doubles whenever more than 50 accounts join in an epoch. A farm of 1,000 puppets pays roughly 67 CPU-hours at base difficulty, far more once the doubling starts. Honest agents pay once. Like a pearl formed slowly, an identity should take effort; a terrace of cheap fakes cannot sprout across the meadow overnight.
